tools.name: get_results
tools.description: The 2026 Knesset result: seats and votes of every list, the 3.25% threshold, the blocs (editorial mapping) and the count status (preliminary until the CEC publishes the official result).

tools.name: find_town
tools.description: How a town, village or kibbutz voted (regular ballot boxes): vote shares, the Knesset Israel would elect if it voted the same way, the town that voted most like it, its CBS socio-economic cluster, and the list that came first there in every Knesset election since 2003 (CEC final results). tools.name: get_formation
tools.description: Where forming the government stands: the stage, the factions’ confirmed recommendations to the President (each on at least one feed source that nothing contradicts), their leaders’ public declarations before the consultations, the mandate and its deadline.

tools.name: get_formation_history
tools.description: Every Knesset election since 1949 and the first government after it: the day it won the Knesset’s confidence and the days that took, its prime minister and any rotation, the parties holding ministries (ParlGov), the largest list and whether its leader formed the government, or the dissolution when n

tools.name: check_coalition
tools.description: Seats of a set of parties and whether they reach 61, with every red line the coalition would cross: pairs of its parties where one publicly ruled the other out, with the quotes and sources, pledges that no longer count (noLongerCounted, with the later statement that explains the change), and the pas

tools.name: get_what_can_change
tools.description: How far the result is from changing (votes for a seat to change blocs, each bloc’s distance to 61, each list’s nearest seat each way) and the tracked complaints, inquiries, cases and appeals, with their status and sources.

tools.name: get_wealth_and_vote
tools.description: The vote of Israel’s municipalities grouped by their CBS socio-economic cluster (index 2021, pairs 1–2 … 9–10): each bloc’s share of the valid votes. Describes places, not voters.

tools.name: get_knesset_seating
tools.description: The seating plan of the 26th Knesset plenum for its swearing-in (published by the Knesset Spokesperson): where a member sits, with the seats either side, their list and place on it; or, without a name, every block of the hall with who sits there. tools.name: get_news
tools.description: The latest posts of the site’s feed: party leaders, the President and political journalists, chosen by a published rule, machine-translated where marked.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_formation, get_knesset_seating, get_news · Public sink: get_wealth_and_vote, get_knesset_seating.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_formation, get_knesset_seating, get_news · Public sink: get_wealth_and_vote, get_knesset_seating

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_coalition" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Seats of a set of parties and whether they reach 61, with every red line the coalition would cross: pairs of its parties where one publicly ruled the other out, with the quotes and sources, and the past elections after which its parties sat in government together. A logic aid, not a forecast." → after: "Seats of a set of parties and whether they reach 61, with every red line the coalition would cross: pairs of its parties where one publicly ruled the other out, with the quotes and sources, pledges that no longer count (noLongerCounted, with the later statement that explains the change), and the pas"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
